title: skills(pm-dispatch): rank a forced takeover below an in-flight claim
body:
Fixes #17033

Governed surface (`.claude/**`) — draft only; a human merge is the review record.

Maintainer ruling implemented (verbatim, as quoted on the card): 「如果你的当前任务对方也在处理了，那技能有问题，需要更新，强制接管也不应该抢已经在处理的任务。」

## What changed — three files, every ceiling net-zero (SKILL.md 812/812 · core-rules 151/151 · seat-post-protocol 91/91)

Base `143c715`; head `5d1d938`. Line numbers below are at the base; bytes are UTF-8 (`MAX_LINE_BYTES = 120`, CJK is 3 bytes a character).

### `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈座位贴协议〉 — 812 → 812 lines

| line | before | after | bytes |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| :269 → :269 | `` - 接管/移交 = 改正文 + 审计评论(评论只作审计不承载状态),接管压缩是标准步骤。 `` | `` - 维护者强制接管令取席位、队列、未起工卡与待落地 PR;⛔ 不取在飞卡,由原认领者跟完。 `` | 108 → 119 |
| new :270 | — | `` - 子代理 dev 的返回消息、探活与续派只在派发会话;落地或 `Release:` 后归新席位。 `` | 0 → 107 |
| :285 → cut | `` - 经验教训散文不再入技能文本;交接按收尾清单逐步走完,并 `list_triggers` 清点自设定时器。 `` | — | 120 → 0 |
| :286 → :286 | `` - 四段模板、状态词表、接管/退场收尾清单细则见 `references/seat-post-protocol.md`。 `` | `` - 接管/移交 = 改正文 + 审计评论(只作审计);收尾清单等细则见 `references/seat-post-protocol.md`。 `` | 104 → 119 |

Two lines added, two paid. The dispatch's suggested one-liner measures 171 bytes and the 「fold :269 and :286」 payment measures 160 bytes, so neither fits the 120-byte cap; the construct is kept and split: :269 carries scope + prohibition + 原认领者跟完, :270 carries the mechanism + the hand-back.

### `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/core-rules.md` 〈座位贴协议〉 — 151 → 151 lines

| line | before | after | bytes |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| :78 → :78 | `` - 交接按收尾清单逐步走完并清点自设定时器;归档自己派出的会话是不可移交的义务。 `` | `` - 交接按收尾清单走完;强制接管 ⛔ 不取在飞卡,由原认领者跟完;归档自派会话不可移交。 `` | 114 → 118 |

Judgment — binding-level: **yes**, so the mirror is owed. (a) SKILL.md :42 ranks 维护者裁决 above AGENTS.md, 红线, 核心条款 and 细则, in that order; a takeover order arrives as a maintainer instruction, so a prohibition that must hold against one has to sit at 核心条款 level, not only among 细则. (b) The digest's 座位贴协议 section already carries the two adjacent hand-off invariants of the same family (:76 在飞安置而非归零, :78 归档不可移交). (c) SKILL.md :44 「一条规则在本文与核心条款一处改动,另一处同 PR 同改」 — once the rule is in SKILL.md and judged core, the same-PR mirror is a requirement, not an option. Rewritten in place: no line added.

### `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md` 交接收尾清单 step 9 — 91 → 91 lines

| line | before | after | bytes |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| :50 → :50 | `` 9. 确须留跑的会话在座位贴里点名,写明归档不随交接转移,⛔ 不留作接任者的欠账。 `` | `` 9. 在飞 dev 卡与留跑会话在贴里点名(卡号 + 派发会话 ID);跟完与归档 ⛔ 不随交接转移。 `` | 111 → 115 |

The step already spoke of sessions that must keep running; it now also names in-flight dev cards with their dispatching session ID, and says that finishing them, like archiving, does not transfer. Rewritten in place: no line added.

## Where every cut rule survives (value gate ②: 「被砍内容若在别处无家,砍掉就是丢规则」)

| cut text | where the rule lives now |
|:--|:--|

| 评论只作审计不承载状态 (from :269) | kept in SKILL.md compressed to 「(只作审计)」 on :286; the body-is-authoritative half is SKILL.md :267 and core-rules :72; seat-post-protocol :14 and :17 say what the audit comment is (an author-stamped reading; a version pointer) |
| 接管压缩是标准步骤 (from :269) | seat-post-protocol :16 「接管压缩:接任 PM 把交接的有效内容按四段模板重述为新正文,编辑历史即存档。」 |
| 经验教训散文不再入技能文本 (from :285) | dispatch-runbook :103 「行文纪律:出处一行,原话仅限操作性判据;⛔ 实测叙事不进操作文本。」; SKILL.md :283 「…⛔ 不是散文」; `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` :20 (the dev-side twin: rules only, lessons written as self-contained rules); the AGENTS.md header (rules only, no incident narrative) |
| 交接按收尾清单逐步走完 (from :285) | core-rules :78 (kept in the rewrite); SKILL.md :695 「维护者交接令(走交接收尾清单)」; seat-post-protocol :40 「交接收尾清单(漏一步就是留残缺现场)」 |
| `list_triggers` 清点自设定时器 (from :285, and from core-rules :78) | seat-post-protocol :47, step 6 of the checklist both surviving lines point at: 「`list_triggers` 清点本会话全部自设定时器,逐个清理或随移交物转交。」 |
| 四段模板、状态词表、接管/退场 (the table-of-contents words on :286) | the reference's own headings (:5, :9, :40) and its lead line :3 — a table of contents, not a rule |
| ⛔ 不留作接任者的欠账 (step 9) | step 8 「归档义务 ⛔ 不可移交」; core-rules :78 「归档自派会话不可移交」; the rewritten step 9 keeps 「归档 ⛔ 不随交接转移」 |
| 归档自己派出的会话是不可移交的义务 (core-rules :78) | kept, compressed: 「归档自派会话不可移交」; twin at step 8 |

## Zone-2 measurements (all at `143c715`)

- **A — holds, with one corrected count.** `grep -n '接管' SKILL.md` hits three lines, not two: :106 (「弃飞无接管」, one of the four release causes in the assignee table row), :269 and :286; none ranks a takeover against an in-flight claim. 「原认领者跟完」 exists for two of the three seat-exit paths — 惰性回收 (dispatch-runbook :52, under 座位贴活性巡查) and epic 僵尸回收 (seat-post-protocol :74, under Epic 车道收尾与僵尸回收, explicitly 「子树内」) — and was absent for the third, 维护者交接令 (SKILL.md :695). The new SKILL.md :269 is what generalises it to that path.
- **B — holds.** os-dev.md :17 / :319 and SKILL.md :565–:566 (「报告通道统一:GitHub 是两种模式共用的真相源;dev 终报先落 issue 评论、再作返回消息」「收集先扫 GitHub,标记评论在 = 报告完整」): the `os-dev-report` comment is written by the dev itself, on the card, before its return message, so it outlives the dispatching session and any seat can read it. What does not transfer: 探活 (:569–:577), 续派 / 停摆复位 (:581–:583) and the return message — a `mode:subagent` dev shares the PM's session (:475 「`mode:subagent` 的 dev 与 PM 同会话同 ID」) and has no handle another session can address. ⇒ the card's proposal 3 (a one-way relay exemption) is moot and is not written; the precedence line plus 「原认领者跟完」 is the whole fix. Proposal 2 lands as the step-9 rewrite, not as a new clause.
- **C — as dispatched.** The precedence line is in SKILL.md 〈座位贴协议〉 (:269–:270), the reference a takeover-ordered seat reads first; the core-rules mirror follows the judgment above.
- **D — verified per cut** (table above). The 「fold :269 and :286」 route measures 160 bytes even with the parenthetical dropped; the 119-byte fold shipped at :286 keeps 改正文 + 审计评论 + 只作审计 + the pointer and loses only the table-of-contents words.

Route on the four axes, briefly: 实际业务需求 — a real, maintainer-confirmed takeover order enumerated 「every `pm:dispatched` card in the lane whatever session claimed it」; the boundary it needed did not exist in the text. 项目长远合理性 — the rule names the mechanism (subagent of the dispatching session; report channel already on GitHub) rather than adding a relay ritual. 防 AI 犯错 — a ⛔ at 核心条款 level is structurally harder to read past than a 细则 line; the checklist step makes the in-flight set explicit (card + session ID) instead of implied. 创业阶段不扩散 — two lines in, two lines out; no new checklist step, no new gate, no ceiling raised.

## Gates (run at `5d1d938`; every exit code captured before any pipe)

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 16 commands from the committed change set; `--ran` reconciles 「16 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED」. Verdict lines:

- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` — exit 0: 「SKILL.md is 812 lines (ceiling 812; headroom 0)」 · 「core-rules.md is 151 lines (ceiling 151; headroom 0)」 · 「seat-post-protocol.md is 91 lines (ceiling 91; headroom 0)」; every line within 120 bytes.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` — exit 0: 「27 file(s) clean」.
- `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync` — exit 0: 「the one declared copy of the decision frame is internally coherent」; md5 of SKILL.md :734–:752 = `22f2339f0acb64cdb50c7adc9db681c3`, unchanged.
- `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose` — exit 0: 「2 instruction surface(s) name all 5 registered governed surfaces」.
- `pnpm check:nul-bytes` — exit 0: 「no raw ASCII control bytes」.
- `pnpm check:pm-governed-merges` — exit 0 (self-test, 274 assertions).
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test` on the three paths — exit 3: 「GOVERNED — a human merge is the review record」, `.claude/**` ×3.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` — first run exit 3 「PREREQUISITE NOT MET」 (unbuilt `@objectstack/formula` / `@objectstack/lint`, nothing measured); built both under the verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`), re-run exit 0.
- `pnpm check:agent-test-spelling`, `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `pnpm check:driver-memory-census`, `pnpm check:refd-timer-probe`, `pnpm check:watch-hint-literal`, `node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs` (and `--self-test`), `node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs`, `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test` — all exit 0.
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (named by the dispatch, not in the derived 16) — exit 0: 「dispatch-gates self-test: 1674 cases pass.」 It ran past the foreground cap; waited on its PID with `tail --pid`.

Declared narrowing: `--ran` reported STALE TREE — a sibling's fetch moved `origin/main` to `d29fdcfa` (five commits) during this run. Zero of those commits touch `.claude/**` or any script behind the 16 derived families (the one script change, `scripts/check-single-claim-paths.mjs`, is an artifact-roster family outside the derived set), so the derivation is unchanged and `main` was not merged into this three-line governed diff. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` sweep is CI-owned and was not run here.

## Acceptance notes

- noted, not filed: the dispatch's grep reading 「hits :269 and :286 only」 misses :106 (「弃飞无接管」); it changes nothing about assumption A. 承接者: the skills seat, when it next refreshes the dispatch text for this lane.
- noted, not filed: a `mode:cloud` dev is a separate session, so its 续派 can technically be delivered by another seat through a poke trigger (seat-post-protocol :33); the new :270 is written for the subagent case, and the mode-blind prohibition on :269 plus checklist step 8 (archive not transferable) cover the cloud case. 承接者: 无 — behaviour is already correct; recorded so the two lines are not read as one.
- Dedup: as given by the dispatch (#17225 and #17244 are queued on other regions of the same files; no card since names takeover). No card filed by this run.

## 维护者速读(草稿)
